description: Implementation of OfficeReadPlatformService for accessing office data, including retrieval of offices, office transactions, and related data, with caching and database queries.

classes.name: OfficeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of OfficeReadPlatformService providing methods to retrieve office and transaction data, with caching and database access.

classes.name: OfficeMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet to OfficeData objects for detailed office information.

classes.name: OfficeDropdownMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet to OfficeData objects for dropdown selections.

classes.name: OfficeTransactionMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet to OfficeTransactionData objects for office transaction details.

methods.name: retrieveAllOffices
methods.description: Retrieves all offices, optionally including all or filtered by hierarchy, with sorting options.

methods.name: retrieveAllOfficesForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves all offices formatted for dropdown selection, based on user hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveOffice
methods.description: Retrieves office details by office ID.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeWithExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves office details by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveNewOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new office.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedParents
methods.description: Retrieves list of valid parent offices for a given office ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllOfficeTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all office transactions visible to the current user.

methods.name: retrieveNewOfficeTransactionDetails
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new office transaction.
